prompt_html: In the Strategy Builder how are option chains displayed?
choices_html: Puts to the left of the screen and calls to the right
Calls to the left of the screen and puts to the right

prompt_html: For a covered call strategy, using the Strategy Builder, how would a user add the stock leg of the trade?
choices_html: Add the call option to the Mosaic Order Entry Panel and close Strategy Builder. Use the Advanced plus sign and locate Add Stock.
At the bottom of the Strategy Builder window is an Order Entry panel. Click the Advanced-plus sign and select Add Stock Leg
Covered call positions must be created separately as two trades: One for the underlying and one for the option.

prompt_html: True or false: For a covered call strategy, the quote display shows the net price of the stock leg minus the premium received for the call option.
